title: Potaroma Dog Puzzle Toy: Remy's Test Notes
description: Remy tested the Potaroma 2-level dog puzzle toy. Here are our notes on using it as a slow feeder and treat puzzle for enrichment and entertainment.
card_summary: A 2-level puzzle toy that turns food or treats into a little job for Remy and helps slow him down.
image_alt: Yellow and teal Potaroma dog puzzle toy with food compartments and sliding covers
lede: This is the kind of product that makes a dog work a little for food instead of inhaling it in ten seconds. Remy tested the Potaroma 2-level puzzle toy as both a slow feeder and a treat puzzle, and it is a nice way to give him something to do while turning mealtime or snack time into a little bit of enrichment.
verdict_title: Remy approved for food puzzles and slower feeding
verdict_text: If you want a simple enrichment option that can double as a slow feeder, this one does a good job of making your dog work a little for food or treats.

surfaces.name: Slow-feeder use
surfaces.note: The two-level setup helps turn food into more of an activity instead of a quick bowl dump.

surfaces.name: Puzzle time
surfaces.note: It works well as a food or treat puzzle when you want to keep Remy busy for a bit.

surfaces.note: This feels more like an enrichment toy than a throw-and-forget toy, which is how we would use it.

what_we_tested:
We tested the Potaroma 2-level puzzle toy by using it as a slow feeder and as a treat puzzle for Remy. The main question for this kind of product is simple: does it actually make a dog work for the food a little instead of just blasting through a normal bowl or easy treat drop?

For Remy, it gave him something to do and turned food time into more of an activity.
what_worked:
The biggest plus is the format. It is a **2-level puzzle toy**, so it feels a little more engaging than a basic slow-feeder bowl. You can use it with food or treats, which makes it flexible depending on whether you are doing mealtime or just trying to keep your dog occupied for a few minutes.

It is also a nice enrichment option if you want your dog to work a little mentally instead of just eating as fast as possible.
what_didnt_work: No major dealbreakers from our test. The main tradeoff is that this is more of a supervised enrichment toy than a toy you toss on the floor and forget about. Like most food puzzles, you also have to take the extra step to load it up and clean it after use.
remys_take: Remy did what Remy usually does with food involved and stayed interested. It gave him something to work on, which is really the whole point of a puzzle toy like this.
worth_buying: Yes, if you want a simple puzzle toy that can double as a slow feeder and a treat dispenser. It is a nice option for adding a little enrichment to your dog's routine without overcomplicating it.

faqs.question: What kind of product is the Potaroma dog puzzle toy?
faqs.answer: It is a 2-level dog puzzle toy that can be used as a slow feeder and a food or treat dispenser.

faqs.question: Can the Potaroma puzzle toy be used with food and treats?
faqs.answer: Yes. We like that it works for regular food or for treats, depending on how you want to use it.

faqs.question: Did Remy like the Potaroma puzzle toy?
faqs.answer: Yes. It kept him engaged and made him work a little for the food, which is what we wanted from it.

faqs.question: Is this more of a slow feeder or a toy?
faqs.answer: A little of both. We would describe it as an enrichment toy that can also work as a slow feeder.
